review_notes: I read the whole file. I searched Mathlib for centralIdempotent, CentralIdempotent, characterSum and IsCentralIdempotent and found no match. The file's definitions are `characterSum`, `characterSumCenter`, `primitiveCentralIdempotent` and `primitiveCentralIdempotentCenter`. I found no Mathlib counterpart for any of them. They build on the library's own class-sum and central-character infrastructure (`classSumCenter`, `ofConjClassesCenter`, `centralCharacter`), which is not a Mathlib duplicate either. The Center-valued variants are thin named wrappers over the plain group-algebra elements. They serve a purpose, because centrality is carried in the type for `centralCharacter`. Mathlib's `IsIdempotentElem` is reused for idempotence, and `Representation.char_orthonormal` is reused for orthogonality. I did not search the rest of the TauCeti library for internal duplicates beyond this check. I found no justified duplicate.
